title: Azure Storage: Blobs, Queues, and Files
description: Store files, messages, and shared data from C# using Azure Blob, Queue, and File storage.
longDescription: Azure Storage is the foundational data plane for many ASP.NET Core applications. In this module, you will create storage accounts, upload and download blobs, send background messages with queues, and mount Azure File shares from C#.
whatYouLearn: Create and configure Azure Storage accounts
Upload, download, and stream blobs from C#
Use queue storage for decoupled background work
Mount and manage Azure File shares
